clauses.quote: A pupil suspended from a class shall not be placed in another regular class during the period of suspension.
clauses.subject_text: A pupil suspended from a class

clauses.quote: The District shall make available in all schools a District form to be used by a teacher in the event the teacher suspends a pupil from his/her class in accordance with this provision.

The site administrator, if he/she has knowledge, shall as soon as reasonably possible provide all unit members having direct supervision responsibilities pertinent information concerning any student who exhibited a potential, actual or immediate danger to unit member(s).
clauses.subject_text: The site administrator, if he/she has knowledge

clauses.quote: District personnel possessing such information shall provide it to the site administrator.
This information, if available, shall be provided prior to the time the student is placed in the classroom(s).
All appropriate staff shall be notified of seriously disruptive students as required and authorized by law.
Any verified incident involving any student at a site that is deemed "threatening" as defined by law shall be reported to all appropriate staff as soon as reasonable possible.
clauses.subject_text: Any verified incident involving any student at a site that is deemed "threatening" as defined by law
clauses.notes: Duty falls on staff encountering the incident.

clauses.quote: If a unit member is assaulted or threatened while in the performance of duties pursuant to his/her job description and/or other assigned duties, the unit member shall immediately inform the administrator
both shall report such assault or threat to the SAUSD School Police or Santa Ana Police Department or both.
No unit member shall be required to be supervising students more than 2½ hours consecutively without being provided a break of a minimum of 7½ minutes.
clauses.notes: Grants relief from consecutive supervision duty.
